base_action_assumption: recorded: the frozen policy's base chunk sequence is assumed unchanged by the residual, which is FALSE in general (pi0.5 replans every chunk). The approximation is identical across arms and cannot explain a between-arm difference.

phi_target.join: exact (episode, t); every tape row required to match exactly one label row, extra label rows (the terminal boundary) permitted

head_input_selection.match: sha256 content subset of base inputs

contract.normalization: base-train current z only; fixed for all arms
contract.prior_data: selected head-tape episodes in base-train only
contract.phi_data: selected head-tape episodes in base-train only
contract.head_metrics: selected head-tape episodes in base-holdout only
contract.head_tapes_default: all base tapes when --head-tapes is omitted
contract.targets: explicit tape z_next; no shifted-z surrogate

belief_stats_source: beliefs of the 'updated_shuffled' arm over real rows; run_v206 ignores bmu/bsd under condition='raw' and no belief enters an observed/current advantage
